messages:
maria: Quick check — I spotted an on-prem container image that includes /etc/service-account.json. It looks like a wrapped blob, not plaintext, but want to confirm policy: are wrapped blobs allowed inside images or must all secrets be fetched at runtime? Also who signs off on emergency rotations for on-prem keys?
ashwin: wrapped blobs ok only if the unwrap happens via a customer-managed HSM/Vault at runtime. Nothing that can be unwrapped by a static credential in the image.
maria: here's the top of the file (redacted): ```{ "type": "service_account", "wrapped_key": "REDACTED", "created_by": "ci-deploy" }```
jen: cc @ops-sre for runtime ops constraints and logging requirements
ops-sre: we require: 1) unwrap call uses a host-bound HSM or vault agent, 2) unwrap principal is not stored in image, 3) unwrap calls are logged to audit system, and 4) application logs must be scrubbed of any token output. If it's cloud KMS without HSM, it's only allowed for staging and must be ACL-limited.
paul: for approvals — eng leads can approve dev/staging rotations; prod/on-prem customer HSM rotations need security + infra sign-off. We have a short runbook for emergency rotate (link): https://go/runbooks/secret-rotate (internal).
security-bot: automated-scan: run `./scripts/secret-audit --path images --filter service_account` — match found in repo `infra/onprem-service`, file `Dockerfile` layer `/etc/service-account.json`.
maria: ok I'll run the audit and open a PR to: move unwrap into an init container that talks to vault, add log redaction, and remove file from image layers. can someone confirm who approves staging rotation?
jen: I can approve staging rotation. :thumbsup:
ashwin: I'll review the PR tomorrow — please add a test that asserts logs do not contain the wrapped_key string (basic redaction test).
maria: thanks all, creating PR now and will ping when ready
